Regarding the operational processes described in the text, the primary bottleneck is the centralized location of the tool and material repository. This setup forces workers to travel significant distances across the work site, leading to lost productivity due to excessive time spent commuting between the repository and various construction areas.

To improve efficiency, AutoBuild should consider decentralizing the repository. Implementing mobile tool carts or establishing smaller, localized material staging areas closer to active construction zones would reduce travel time, minimize downtime, and enhance overall worker productivity.
